title: F11 · rejections · We Regret to Inform You
lines: We regret to inform you. Forty-seven times.
"We regret to inform you." Forty-seven times.
She has stopped telling her parents about interviews.
Her friends are posting first-salary photos.
The auto driver had a small Shiva on his dashboard, holding a bow.
He waited a thousand years. And then he needed only one arrow.
You do not need forty-eight yeses. You need one. Keep the bow up. That is sadhana.
